name: Maai
overview: Maai was a male Levite known for his role involving musical instruments, as recorded in Nehemiah 12:36. His identity as a Levite places him within the tribe entrusted with temple duties and worship in Israel. There are no additional notes recorded about him beyond his musical service.
namesAndTitles: The name Maai means 'to be compassionate,' which is a proper name mentioned in Nehemiah 12:36. This meaning reflects a character trait valued in the biblical context, though the name was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Maai as a descendant of Levi, connecting him to the priestly tribe responsible for worship and temple service. Beyond this tribal affiliation, no further family relationships are recorded for him.
scriptureSignificance: Maai's significance lies in his role as a Levite musician during the temple worship restoration described in Nehemiah. His involvement with musical instruments highlights the importance of worship through music in the post-exilic community's dedication to God. As a Levite, Maai contributed to the spiritual renewal of Israel by supporting the temple service, emphasizing the centrality of reverent praise in the life of God's people.
